mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy shift, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate rise exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.3pp, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in >50% of cases over 3 years, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (indicating supply contraction) signals manufacturing weakness, reducing corporate profit margins and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of INDPRO < 100 periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting restrictive monetary policy and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of CPIAUCSL >3.5% (y/y) periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in employment (PAYEMS) signals strong labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of PAYEMS increase periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer spending (RSAFS) exceeding 750,000 million signals robust demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of RSAFS >750000 periods, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous industrial production decline (INDPRO < 100) and unemployment rate rise (UNRATE > 4.5%) indicate dual market shocks, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint INDPRO < 100 and UNRATE > 4.5% condition fails to predict negative returns in >50% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.01.
